Wizard.Title: Set up Juvin
Wizard.Welcome.Title: Welcome to Juvin
Wizard.Welcome.Body: Juvin rewrites the email you are drafting using the conversation it replies to. These steps connect it to your browser and to a model.
Wizard.Checklist.Title: Setup checklist
Wizard.Checklist.Body: These items let Juvin work on this computer. Required items must be done before you can finish.
Wizard.Done.Title: You are ready
Wizard.Done.Body: Select a draft in your browser and press {0} to rewrite it.
App.Name: Juvin
Home.Title: Home
Home.Subtitle: What Juvin needs to rewrite your drafts, and whether it is ready.
Home.ConnectorHint: Lets Juvin read the draft and thread you are working on.
Home.ModelHint: The model that writes the rewrite.
Home.ShortcutHint: The key combination that starts a rewrite.
Home.RecentHint: Rewrites appear here when history is turned on in Privacy and data.
Home.SetupHint: Walk through the setup steps again.
Shortcuts.Title: Shortcuts
Shortcuts.Subtitle: The keys that start a rewrite from any app.
Shortcuts.RewriteHint: Captures the selected draft and opens the rewrite panel.
Shortcuts.BackendHint: How this computer delivers the shortcut to Juvin.
Shortcuts.ExtensionMirrorHint: The same shortcut inside the browser, kept in step with this one.
RewriteActions.Title: Rewrite actions
RewriteActions.Subtitle: What Juvin can do to a draft.
RewriteActions.BuiltInHint: Improve, shorten, make friendlier, make more formal, and more. Each prompt can be edited.
RewriteActions.DefaultHint: The action used when you press the shortcut.
BrowserConnector.Title: Browser connector
BrowserConnector.Subtitle: Connects Juvin to the browser extension that reads and replaces your draft.
BrowserConnector.DetectedHint: Browsers on this computer and whether Juvin is registered with each.
BrowserConnector.ExtensionHint: Install links for the Juvin extension in each browser store.
BrowserConnector.TestHint: Checks that the extension can reach Juvin.
Models.Title: Models
Models.Subtitle: Where your drafts are rewritten.
Models.ModeHint: Local runs on this computer or your network. Codex uses your signed-in Codex CLI.
Models.LocalModelHint: Pick a model from the server and check that it can rewrite.
PrivacyAndData.Title: Privacy and data
PrivacyAndData.Subtitle: What Juvin keeps on this computer. Nothing is kept unless you turn it on.
PrivacyAndData.HistoryHint: Keep past rewrites on this computer, removed after the retention period.
PrivacyAndData.ProvenanceHint: Record which model and prompt produced each rewrite.
PrivacyAndData.CrashHint: Off by default. Reports never include email content.
PrivacyAndData.DeleteAllHint: Remove history, settings, and stored keys.
General.Title: General
General.Subtitle: How Juvin starts and behaves on this computer.
General.LaunchAtLoginHint: Start Juvin in the background when you sign in.
General.CloseToTrayHint: Closing the window keeps Juvin running in the system tray.
General.NoTrayHint: No system tray was found, so closing the window exits Juvin.
About.Title: About
About.LicenseHint: Juvin is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3.
About.DiagnosticsHint: Export logs for a bug report. Logs never contain email content.
Wizard.Checklist.Empty: Nothing extra to set up on this computer.
